fair_value.method: Blend of a pro forma sum-of-the-parts on an at-close basis (~331M basic shares, ~$0.75B net debt plus ~$0.135B Ara preferred = ~$0.885B net claims, OSC loan excluded as conditional and net-debt neutral) (~$9.2, 60%), a 6x EV/sales cross-check on ~$720M run-rate pro forma revenue (~$10.1, 30%) and a 40%-haircut sell-side consensus target (~$14.5, 10%).

methods.name: SOTP
methods.inputs: At VAC close (early 2027), assets and claims on the same date. Uranium EV $1.1B (~2.0M lb/yr at ~$80 realized vs ~$23-35/lb cost, ~$80-100M EBITDA x 11-12x plus resources); REE platform (White Mesa Phase 1/2 + Vara Mada, company NPV ~$3.7B) risked ~35% = $1.3B; Donald 49% earn-in $0.15B (combined Ph1+2 pre-tax NPV8 A$2.3B, EF share ~US$0.7B, risked ~20% because FID has slipped past Q3-2026); ASM $0.15B; VAC $1.1B (2027 EBITDA $60-90M, midpoint $75M x 15); inventory/vanadium/other $0.15B. EV ~$3.95B less net claims ~$0.885B ($936.7M cash+securities at 6/30 less $718M VAC cash, ~$24M ASM cash, ~$100M burn/capex to close = ~$95M cash; vs $700M converts at $20.34 conv. and $140M VAC net debt refinanced by $250M Goldman loan; plus up to $135M Ara preferred, likely triggered below $20.93) = ~$3.07B / 331M = ~$9.26, less ~$0.1/share expected discount cost of an equity raise if the conditional $725M OSC loan fails (~35% probability, ~$300M raise needed for 2027 REE capex) = ~$9.2.

methods.name: EV/sales
methods.inputs: Run-rate 2027 revenue: consensus ~$262M standalone + ~$460M VAC (third-party ~EUR400M; company discloses only $29M 2025 adj. EBITDA) = ~$720M; 6.0x EV/sales = EV ~$4.32B less ~$0.885B net claims = ~$3.44B / 331M = ~$10.4, cut to ~$10.1 for execution risk and the fact VAC contributes only part of calendar 2027 after an early-2027 close.

methods.name: other
methods.inputs: Sell-side consensus 12-month target ~$24.15 (8 analysts, range $16-$32.50) haircut 40% for historical optimism of targets on critical-minerals stories and targets largely set before the Aug-Sep drawdown.

bear.story: The conditional OSC $725M loan is not finalized, leaving ~$95M of cash after the VAC close against heavy REE capex, forcing a discounted equity raise on top of the 65.85M-share Ara issuance (19.9% holder overhang) and the ~$135M preferred; VAC close slips on German FDI/antitrust; Sumter ramps slowly (VAC 2027 EBITDA near $60M); US-China rare-earth thaw compresses the policy premium; Donald FID slips again; uranium drifts to the $70s. Market prices near a risked NAV of ~$6 with losses continuing.

base.story: VAC closes ~Q1 2027, OSC loan finalized in some form during 2027, uranium ~$85-95 with ~2M lb/yr at ~$25-35/lb, heavy REE circuit on track for late-2027 Tb/Dy, VAC EBITDA running ~$70-80M; sector sentiment mixed. Stock trades around a pro forma SOTP of ~$10 with high volatility.

bull.story: Renewed US-China rare-earth tension or US price-floor/offtake support, OSC loan closes early removing dilution risk, Sumter pipeline converts into contracts and 4,000 tpa expansion is funded, uranium breaks above $100, heavy REE qualified with customers; strategic multiple returns toward the ~$24 consensus and the $27.90 high.

thesis_break_reason: At ~$6.2 the equity is ~$2.05B on ~331M shares; adding ~$0.885B of net claims at close gives an EV of ~$2.9B, roughly uranium (~$1.1B) plus VAC at ~$1.1B plus little else, i.e. almost nothing for the REE upstream, Donald or ASM. Trading there would most likely mean something fundamental broke rather than 70-90% volatility: VAC close failed or was renegotiated, the OSC loan fell through and a large discounted equity raise was needed, a major REE write-down (Vara Mada/Madagascar), or uranium below ~$65/lb.

reasoning: Energy Fuels (UUUU) is a low-cost US uranium producer becoming a leveraged, stock-funded mine-to-magnet platform. Round 2 applies the supervisor's verified facts: ~331M basic shares post-ASM/VAC (249.97M at 7/31 + ~14.8M ASM + 65.853M VAC = 19.9%); net debt at close ~$0.75B plus up to $0.135B Ara preferred (likely triggered with the stock far below $20.93); the $725M OSC loan is still only a conditional commitment (confirmed: no finalization found through late Sept 2026), net-debt neutral and earmarked for White Mesa and the metals plant, not the VAC cash leg; VAC revenue ~EUR400M third-party only; Donald FID has slipped past Q3-2026. I rebuilt the SOTP on an at-close basis so assets and claims share a date (my round-1 $0.96B was end-2027 without crediting the capex), trimmed VAC 2027 EBITDA to a $75M midpoint of the $60-90M range ($1.1B vs $1.2B), nudged Donald up slightly given the A$2.3B combined NPV8 but risked for FID slippage, and added a small expected cost for an OSC-failure equity raise. Net effect: SOTP ~$9.2 (from $9.5), EV/sales ~$10.1 (from $9.8, lower net claims), blended fair value ~$10.0 (from $10.1) versus the supervisor's reconciled $9.6; I stay slightly above it because I risk the REE platform and Donald at non-trivial value. Distribution: lognormal-like, ~72% log-vol (below the 89% trailing because the uranium business and at-close balance sheet anchor value), median moved up from ~$10.2 to ~$10.4 because the corrected at-close net claims are lower than my round-1 figure; P(>=11.35) 0.45 (from 0.44). I remain a touch below the group mean (0.46) deliberately: fair value sits ~12% below spot, the Ara share/preferred issuance and a possible post-close funding raise are concentrated inside the horizon, and the trend is negative (near the 52-week low), while the right tail stays fat (P>=28 ~8%) for policy-driven re-ratings. Left tail trimmed slightly (sub-$3 unlikely given ~$0.9B liquidity pre-close and producing uranium assets). Scenario mean ~$11.6 is consistent with a skewed distribution whose median is ~$10.4. Options data and the priors folder were not consulted; research in round 2 was limited to 4 searches.
